svg.text: the walk down from game to player, drawn at 1280 px · a model exists from P6; every probability here is made up
RECORDED · pass anchored · play-by-play version 4 · model wp-0.0 (made up) · curve: as of event; forecasts: as known before each span
Home win probability, band 95 %, model wp-0.0 (made up)
